_comment: Per-repo adoption manifest (feature 078, FR-017/019/020/021). The sole authority for whether FR-008 binds in glpnet. Every area in codeconv.receipts.manifest.GLPNET_AREAS MUST be enumerated exactly once; an area absent from this list is an ERROR (FR-020), never a pass and never equivalent to non-adoption. A state that is not one of adopted|non-adopted is refused rather than interpreted, because the consumer gates on equality with 'non-adopted' and any other value would silently take ADOPTED semantics.
_fr017_six_areas: FR-017 names SIX areas. This repo declares FIVE and that is CORRECT, not an undischarged narrowing: engineer ruling Q-GLPNETS12-02 (2026-08-31, 'Split 11 / 55') scoped 078 in glpnet to its eleven glpnet-side tasks and five areas, and recorded the buildkit-side 3rtask and codexreview areas as a buildkit-owned successor with 078 as its spec of record. DECLARED COST, CARRIED KNOWINGLY: FR-017's six-area guarantee is then satisfied by NO SINGLE REPO, so any fleet adoption claim must read this manifest AND buildkit's together. The same split is applied one level down by codeconv/tests/faultinj/instances.py, where seven of the thirteen witnessed instances read UNREAD with owner=buildkit (Q-GLPNETS14-01).

areas.note: test/receipts/{emit.sh,assert.sh} emit conforming receipts and hold 7/7 parity with the Python emitter (T042-T044, FR-024); the pytest suite emits its SC-001 instance-coverage receipt (T029b)

instance 6 is injected and asserted in codeconv/tests/faultinj/test_compile_only_gate.py, but the PRODUCTION codeconv build gate does not yet emit a receipt — T054. Non-adopted is the honest state until it does.
instance 8 (poll/cursor defects) is buildkit-owned; the glpnet COOP surface emits no receipt yet
instances 4 and 13 are buildkit-owned (bk-roadmap import/replay/reconcile); the glpnet side emits no receipt yet
